blogTagline: Notes on recording and transcribing calls on a Mac.
ctaText: If that sounds like how you'd want to work, Transcriber is free and runs on your Mac. If not, no hard feelings, there are plenty of other ways to get a transcript.
aiNote: This article was written with the help of AI, based on how Transcriber actually works, and read and approved by Moritz Krause before publishing.
